text:
Zoe (Marketing): Quick sync  social plan for the July 12 webinar (benchmark + troubleshooting). Need: X + LinkedIn main posts, a 3-tweet thread, 2 hero images, 4 quote cards, and a seedlist. Who owns 24h monitoring?
Ravi (Social): I'll take US hours. Proposed times: X at 08:45 PT, LinkedIn at 09:15 PT. Also plan a thread 2h later with key takeaways. Want to A/B test headline (stat vs. question).
Hana (Content): Drafted variants: Stat: "Learn how teams cut token spend up to 3x." Question: "Want lower latency and lower costs? Join our live demo." For paid we should use the stat (with 'up to').
Marco (Growth): Paid = stat. I'll sponsor $2k. Need sanitized seedlist (ML infra, platform eng leads). Also need UTMs.
Ty (Design): Assets ETA tomorrow morning. Delivering hero-wide.png + hero-square.png and 4 quote cards (png). Will include alt text drafts.
Zoe (Marketing): Monitoring rota: Ravi first 12h, Marco covers evening spikes. HubSpot-Bot will tag inbound as webinar-jul12 and create SDR tasks.
HubSpot-Bot: Created tag webinar-jul12. Webhook ready to post to #inbound on paid-register clicks.
Ravi (Social): Amplification plan: employee amp brief (1-liner + 3 bullets), micro-boosts at +2h, +10h, +24h. I'll draft employee copy and a small schedule CSV.
Hana (Content): Engagement replies for the team: "Thanks  here's the link to register: https://redwood.ai/jul12"; DM template: "Hi {first}, saw your comment  are you evaluating latency/costs now? Can we intro you to an engineer?"
Marco (Growth): UTM example: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_jul12&utm_content=variantA. Seedlist note: prioritize accounts with recent infra churn signals.
Ty (Design): Quick ask: leave 25% safe area on right for headline overlay. I'll post layout in Figma.
Zoe (Marketing): Checklist: captions and CTAs locked by EOD today, assets in drive by 10am PT tomorrow, seedlist to Marco by 9am tomorrow, monitoring doc live 30m before publish. Any blockers?
Ravi (Social): Scheduling draft will be in the drive in 45m. I'll include both headline variants and CTA A/B (Register vs See demo).
Marco (Growth): Will upload sanitized CSV by 08:50 PT tomorrow.
Ty (Design): Not blocked. Pulling logo lockup from Brand now.
Zoe (Marketing): Great work team  I'll confirm once the scheduling doc is live. :rocket:
